children: Bermaz Auto's loss of its XPeng distribution is unlikely to materially affect its earnings outlook, it could be largely offset by a a stronger performance from its Mazda sales, Maybank IB analyst Loh Yan Jin says in a note. Based on her estimates, XPeng's contribution to Bermaz Auto's pretax profit is estimated to have fallen to less than 5% in 1Q FY 2027, from 27% in FY 2026. Steady Mazda sales, a favorable mix of higher-margin completely built-up models and forex hedging should support earnings, she reckons. The launch of the locally assembled Mazda CX-5 in mid-2027 and expanded assembly operations are expected to provide further growth, she adds. Maybank maintains a buy rating on Bermaz Auto and keeps target price at 1.35 ringgit. Shares are 2.4% lower at 0.81 ringgit.(yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
